response.justification: Bogdan is a deeply experienced generalist engineer (15+ years) with strong full-stack, distributed systems, and developer-tooling credentials, plus genuine consulting, teaching, and mentoring signals that map well to the customer-facing, technical-leadership half of this Staff FDE role. However, the core requirement — 8+ years building production AI solutions — is not met; AI/agentic exposure appears limited to roughly the last year at re:cinq (MCP code generators and agentic workflow frameworks). The resume shows no Python, no vector databases, no RAG architectures, no LLM evaluation/observability work, and only incidental cloud experience (AWS CDK). He could plausibly ramp quickly given the MCP work and breadth, but on paper he is well short of the staff-level GenAI bar.
strengths: 15+ years shipping production systems across web, backend, mobile, and embedded; strong TypeScript/Node depth
Demonstrated mentoring, workshops, courses, and conference talks — fits technical-leadership and customer-facing duties
Hands-on MCP server/code-generator and agentic workflow tooling experience at re:cinq
concerns: Only ~1 year of AI-related work versus the 8+ year production-AI requirement
No evidence of RAG, vector databases, LLM evaluation/observability, or multi-agent frameworks
Python absent from skills; cloud/AI platform experience limited to AWS CDK, no GCP/Azure AI stack

key_factors.factor: Missing RAG / vector DB / cloud AI stack
Senior engineering breadth, mentoring, and MCP/agent tooling
